title: Fish Oils and Soybean Lecithin Supplementation Modulate Immune Function in Runners

sections.abstract: The purpose of this study was evaluate the comparative effects of FO rich in EPA (FO-EPA) and FO rich in DHA (FO-DHA) on inflammation and neutrophil properties after a prolonged and strenuous exercise. The effect of soybean lecithin on the same parameters and conditions also was evaluated.
